title: Fig Asks for Help
checkpoint: Year 1 Autumn 1, week 3 — School readiness — Phase 5: new sounds ue, aw, tch

pages.text: Fig is in the big barn.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar crawling along a dusty beam inside an old wooden barn.

pages.text: Fig spots a bug stuck in sap.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar spotting a small bug stuck fast in a blob of amber sap.
Close view of the thick, sticky amber sap holding the bug in place.

pages.text: Fig tries to drag the bug free.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar straining to pull the stuck bug loose from the sap.

pages.text: This job is too big for Fig.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar pausing, out of breath, the bug still stuck.
Fig the caterpillar calling up towards Olive the owl perched above.
Olive the owl flying in through the open barn door.
Olive the owl and Fig the caterpillar both pulling the stuck bug together.

pages.text: The bug is free at last.
pages.illustration: The small bug finally coming loose from the sap, sap stretching behind it.
Fig the caterpillar and Olive the owl smiling together in the barn.
